label: GO step after an unrewarded common a2->S2 trial
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (0 at D1/D2), and only when the reward input at the preceding D1 was 0 (never after a reward). Nearly all mass (84% of known-history mass) comes after the previous trial chose a2 and reached S2 via a common transition; it is essentially silent after a1 or rare transitions (prev_action==1: 81 of 25567 activations). About 16% of activations are at the window first GO (rel -3), where the previous trial is outside the window, so the predicate cannot match them; this is the main source of missed recall. The agent usually picks a2 again when the feature fires (model_act==2 for 97% of the mass; policy logit strongly toward a2). Adding model_act==2 (the agent own upcoming choice) raises dev F1 only from 0.74 to 0.76, so I recorded the simpler predicate that uses only observed history. Precision is about 0.67: many GO steps after a2-S2c-unrewarded stay silent, and conditioning on the reward two trials back or on the hidden good state did not separate them. Magnitude is not explained here. Does not fire after rewarded trials, after a1 choices, or after rare transitions. No future variables are used.
